events.name: Japan GDP (Q-o-Q)
events.description: Preliminary estimate of Japan's second-quarter economic growth, a key gauge of momentum ahead of BoJ policy decisions.

events.name: China Retail Sales (Y-o-Y)
events.description: Tracks the annual growth in Chinese consumer spending, a key gauge of domestic demand strength.

events.name: UK Unemployment Rate
events.description: Share of the UK workforce actively seeking work, a core signal of labour market slack for the BoE.

events.name: US Industrial Production (M-o-M)
events.description: Measures the monthly change in US factory, mining and utility output, a gauge of manufacturing sector health.

events.name: US FOMC Meeting Minutes
events.description: Detailed record of the Fed's July policy meeting, offering insight into the outlook for interest rates.

events.name: UK CPI (Y-o-Y)
events.description: Annual change in UK consumer prices, the BoE's primary gauge of inflation for setting interest rates.

events.name: China Loan Prime Rate (1-Year)
events.description: PBoC's benchmark lending rate, a key policy tool influencing borrowing costs across the Chinese economy.

events.name: US Initial Jobless Claims
events.description: Weekly count of new unemployment benefit claims, a timely read on the health of the US labour market.

events.name: Eurozone Services PMI (Flash)
events.description: Preliminary gauge of activity in the eurozone's dominant services sector, signalling growth momentum for the bloc.

events.name: Japan National Core CPI (Y-o-Y)
events.description: Japan's annual inflation rate excluding fresh food, closely watched by the BoJ for sustained price pressure.
